description:
Farm Steam trading cards, manage achievements, and idle games automatically — an all-in-one alternative to ArchiSteamFarm, Steam Achievement Manager, and Idle Master

Steam Game Idler (SGI) is a Steam automation tool for farming trading cards, managing achievements, and boosting playtime across all games in your Steam library.
## What's Changed
• feat(customization)：add animated signature themes by @zevnda in https://github.com/zevnda/steam-game-idler/pull/2171
• build(deps)：bump heroui, autostart, fumadocs and typescript-eslint by @zevnda in https://github.com/zevnda/steam-game-idler/pull/2182
• build(deps)：bump window-state fork to stop the window growing taller… by @zevnda in https://github.com/zevnda/steam-game-idler/pull/2184
• feat：support archived achievements by @zevnda in https://github.com/zevnda/steam-game-idler/pull/2185
• refactor(customization)：remove automatic holiday themes by @zevnda in https://github.com/zevnda/steam-game-idler/pull/2187
• refactor(ui)：remove ad iframe from sidebar by @zevnda in https://github.com/zevnda/steam-game-idler/pull/2188


**Full Changelog**：https://github.com/zevnda/steam-game-idler/compare/6.2.12...6.2.13
